description: This file implements the DistanceGrid class for spatial partitioning in a mapping library, managing objects and their coordinates efficiently.

classes.name: L.DistanceGrid
classes.description: A class for spatial indexing that manages objects within a grid based on their coordinates, allowing efficient proximity queries.

methods.name: addObject(obj, point)
methods.description: Adds an object to the grid at a specified point.

methods.name: updateObject(obj, point)
methods.description: Updates the position of an object within the grid.

methods.name: removeObject(obj, point)
methods.description: Removes an object from the grid.

methods.name: eachObject
methods.description: Iterates over all objects in the grid, applying a callback function.

methods.name: getNearObject
methods.description: Finds the closest object to a given point within neighboring grid cells.

methods.name: _getCoord
methods.description: Calculates grid coordinate based on an x value.

methods.name: _sqDist
methods.description: Calculates squared distance between two points.
